title: Lovely app interface but needs tweaking
body:
Love the simple design of the app. I’ve looked at other apps and find they are crammed with so much info that you can’t see at a glance the info you require, where this is sleek looking and straightforward. I also love the idea of growing a little tree. Gives you that little extra motivation to complete your goals. The little info section is also a nice touch. 

What let’s this app down and my reason for three stars instead of five, is the lack of badges or countdown within the app. Say, for example, your goal was to drink 6 glasses of water a day. You can tap on the goal you have created but there is no way to see what’s remaining. So it’s really hard to keep track with what you have completed and what’s left. I do find this part of the app particularly disappointing, which is a shame. 

The reminders too are a little hit and miss. Sometimes they work and other times they don’t. It would be helpful if the app displayed badges for overdue items. It would also be helpful if you could tweak the reminder times for weekdays and weekends. 

These are just simple things but do impact on the app’s overall performance. If these items could be addressed I would happily give a 5 ⭐️ review

body: The app doesn’t display a badge when a reminder is overdue. It reminds you to complete tasks after you’ve marked  them as complete, if you’ve completed them before the reminder time. author: shufflesheep

title: Habits to grow a plant!
body:
I really like this app. It is simple and effective. It allows you to ‘win’ and doesnt punish you if you dont achieve tasks.  It is designed in the same vein (digital group) as Headspace and i love it. Your completions lead to growing a plant.. and why not a forest in time or other things. I am not a game player but why not have something more...  

It has lost a star because if a few things: 
1. I want to screen shot a friend and it wont let me do that without taking a number of screen shots. 
2. I would (at times) like to see how i have done over a week or a month with no’z not a bar chart. Cos the small changes daily lead to habit formation over time. 
3. Some habits can be am & pm, but i cant add them in apart from seperately and then (1) happens.

title: Great app, just missing a few final tweaks
body:
I really love the UI of the app and how easy it is to use. The addition of the plant is great and provides an extra reason to log in each day. There are just a few things missing that would get it to 5*. 

I would love the ability to track individual habit streaks so we can see which ones have been lacking. It would also be great to easily re organise the order of the habits - when doing a morning routine I like to check the habits off in order, and if any of these change for some reason it’s a manual process of renaming each one. 

Overall though, happy with it and as a paid subscriber I am looking forward to updates!
